text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Loves, happy birthdayyy!! I've got a very 
special present ready for you!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I searched and seaaaarched everywhere— and 
finally found the perfect one!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "Wah~ what could it be!\nI'm so excited♪"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! A fluffy heart pillow the same 
color as Loves's hair. It's perfect for 
Loves, right?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
During your streams, you're sometimes 
hugging a cushion, right?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Looking at that, it just clicked! When it 
comes to Loves, it's gotta be hearts!!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
If there's a heart on screen, both Loves 
and everyone watching will end up super 
happy, y'know!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait a second, can I do an emergency 
livestream? I need to share these 
feelings."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I totally thought you were going to give 
me something you liked yourself, 
Blast-san! Honestly, that would have been 
the best thing ever for me.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And yet! You looked at me so carefully, 
thought suuuper hard, and picked it out 
for me, right?!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Normally, you can't find anything with the 
exact same color as my hair! And yet you 
did... aww, that's pure love♡
